research_venue.Name: Klappe am Hoeschpark
research_venue.Description: A historic 'Klappe' public toilet is described by a gay-szene.net entry at Kirchderner Straße 37 near Dortmund's Hoeschpark. The entry advertises 08:00–18:00 and internal fixtures, but none is official contemporary operational confirmation. A post dated 16 March 2026 seeks partners and praises the location but does not actually document an encounter; 2024–2025 comments are mixed, with several visitors reporting nobody there. Dortmund's October 2026 open public-toilet dataset is available for future exact record verification, and its Hoeschpark page separately confirms heritage toilet buildings in the park, but neither was matched specifically to this claimed 'Klappe' at present.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Municipal park and shared restroom. 8:00–18:00 hours and special fixtures are only undated directory claims; current public toilet existence/access and permission for sexual activity not confirmed.

research_venue.Name: Parkplatz, Kalkumer Schlossallee
research_venue.Description: Kalkumer Schlossallee is a car park beside a railway crossing and woodland in Düsseldorf-Kalkum. Gay-szene.net's dated posts on 9 March, 12 May and 19 July 2026 claim current cruising and encounters, with mixed ages and daytime activity. These are self-reported, not independent official observation. The city of Düsseldorf issued a September 2026 tender to convert roughly 1,000 m² of the existing parking area into an EV charging facility; the tender states it was still free public parking before a lease. Construction timing after the 21 October bidding deadline has not been verified, so present parking capacity and forest access must be checked.

research_venue.Flag_Reason: Potential future EV charging construction; do not assume September tender has already changed access.; Separate from Angermunder Baggerloch lake (#761), which is 1.2 km away according to directory.

research_venue.Name: Toilette am Südfriedhof
research_venue.Description: The archival listing refers to a public toilet at Südfriedhof Düsseldorf. A 13 July 2026 firsthand visitor says the disabled toilet was locked and the other facilities were in poor condition, with no activity observed. Düsseldorf's municipal toilet inventory lists TWO independent cemetery entrance facilities: Am Südfriedhof 16 (An der Vehlingshecke) and (Südring), each with winter 2026 closing at 17:00 but different morning opening times. The source's old mention of 24-hour access to a disabled cubicle contradicts the latest visitor observation and official schedules; exact entry targeted by the original listing remains ambiguous.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Public cemetery restroom with hours on official municipality site; winter closing 17:00 and disabled-cubicle accessibility must not be assumed. Respect cemetery and nonconsenting users, no sex permission.
research_venue.Flag_Reason: Two different toilet facilities at one cemetery; avoid merging source's unspecified cubicle with a particular modern entrance.; 2026 current eyewitness reports disabled cubicle locked.

research_venue.Name: BAT-Park
research_venue.Description: BAT-Park is the former local name for Gustav-Mahler-Park beside Hamburg's central Alster transport corridor. The gay-szene and Planet Randy directories remember it as a longstanding meeting spot, but substantial 2025 clearance/pruning increased visibility. On 19 July 2026, a first-person contributor observed some men standing and chatting but described little activity; October 2025 and April 2025 visits were negative. Thus there is recent on-site interest, not recent proof of sexual encounters or reliable crowds.

research_venue.Flag_Reason: BAT-Park and Gustav-Mahler-Park same local park name.; July 2026 post is not a verified encounter.; Old secluded area compromised by 2025 vegetation management.
